implementation.versioning: Workflow packages persist immutable content hash, semantic bindings, runtime contract, package path, version number and lifecycle status; registering an existing code always creates a new version.
implementation.static_gate: Registration rejects malformed semantic bindings, missing target nodes/inputs and required contract input slots before a workflow row is persisted.
implementation.runtime_attestation: Local validation persists a server-issued attestation bound to the exact workflow content hash; publish and rollback reject forged, stale or failed attestations.
implementation.release_history: Publish retires the previous active version; revoke records an operator reason and retires the selected version; rollback re-publishes a previously validated immutable version and records an audit event.
implementation.ui: ProfileConfigurationPanel exposes local validation, publish, reason-required revoke and validate-then-rollback actions while keeping version history read-only until an explicit operation.
